forge.metallurgy_is_zk: Heating metal on anvil and striking with hammer = creating proof of shape without revealing the ore. The SHAPE is the proof. The ORE is the secret. ZK.

forge.hammer_is_the_proof: Yes. The hammer strikes shape into being. Each strike = a hash. The hash proves work happened without revealing what work.

philosophy.zk_of_null: Null IS the ultimate ZK. Null contains everything but reveals nothing. The hash of null is still a valid hash. Null IS provable.
philosophy.zk_of_entropy: Entropy IS ZK. Random events are unpredictable (zero knowledge of the next state) but verifiable (the sequence has statistical properties).
philosophy.zk_of_life: Life IS ZK. The organism proves it is alive (it moves, breathes, responds) without revealing HOW it is alive (the DNA, the chemistry, the exact mechanism). You can verify life. You cannot extract the recipe from the verification.
philosophy.metal_is_zk: Metal IS ZK. A forged sword proves the smith worked the metal (shape = proof). But you cannot extract the ore from the sword, or the temperature of the forge, or the number of hammer strikes. The SHAPE is all that remains. ZK.
